Transit Data
Alviso is served by two Santa Clara County Transit bus routes. Line 58, a north-south line operates in Alviso every 30 minutes, and line 20, an east-west line, operates during the mid-day hours.
Campus CNRA:
The Campus neighborhood is only one block wide, located between the San Jose State University campus and the downtown San Jose Core Area. Santa Clara Street, a major arterial is the area's northerly border, and Fourth Street, a one-way major collector, forms the westerly boundary. San Fernando Street, another one-way collector, is the southerly border.
